profile.summary: I am a Software Engineer and I have great passion for technology and what you can accomplish with it.

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Fellow
positions.description: - Participated in the second cohort of Womxn Ignite - a community, think-tank and incubator for women in technology

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Designed and developed a system for improving data quality by providing a C++ interface and data-processing libraries for engineers to apply data transformations across terabyte-scale datasets with a lower risk of data corruption.
- Created a SQL-based data validation system to verify that data transformation results match declared expectations.
- Reduced engineering hours dedicated to fix data by more than 70% and data fix deployment time by 95%.
- Improved data quality by applying the system to fix 200B records across 3 datasets.

positions.title: Analytics Intern
positions.description:
- Increased administrative productivity by developing data visualizations that displayed user engagement KPIs using SQL and Tableau. Previously employees spent time doing KPI calculations, which were automated and refreshed daily.
- Analyzed high, low and negative value actions users do inside the app using SQL to transform data and Python for the analysis. Conclusions were used to create a ML model released into production that predicts whether a user will upgrade.
- Analyzed the performance of several communication strategies to create a more targeted approach. Conclusions were used as evidence for further data-driven decisions regarding new marketing efforts and communication standards.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Designed and developed a plagiarism detection system in C++ to increase automation and reduce manual employee efforts saving ~75 hours a week.​ ​The system was integrated into a crowd compute workflow.
- Created an interactive front-end module that provides plagiarism analysis and saves relevant statistics. Implemented with Angular.js and Typescript.
- Volunteered as a Teaching Assistant for the Google Computer Science Summer Institute, teaching JavaScript and offering general project help to rising first year college students.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Used Power BI and business intelligence tools to analyze the company’s productivity and identify areas for development.
- Worked with Microsoft Azure’s bot framework and with management gathering requirements for an internal chatbot.

honors.title: Honorable Mention of Excelence
honors.description: Acknowledgement to the students graduating in the top 3%.
honors.issuer: Issued by Instituto Tecnológico de Monterrey · May 2017

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteered in a school organization in which we attend a public school once a week to teach mathematics and logical thinking. I worked with fifth graders to further expand their math knowledge and also reflect on human interaction and critical thinking.
We visited a community in García various weeks to help make orchards in order to feed the community.
